description: This file implements an example IPC server and client using socket pairs, with a custom service 'MyExampleService' that echoes a string in uppercase via protobuf RPC. It includes socket setup, process spawning, and RPC handling logic.

classes.name: MyExampleService
classes.description: A custom implementation of the ExampleService protobuf RPC service that converts input text to uppercase and responds.

methods.name: exampleEcho
methods.description: Handles the RPC call, transforms the input string to uppercase, and sets it in the response.

methods.name: onComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when the RPC call completes, sets the 'done' flag to true.

methods.name: childProcessMain
methods.description: Sets up an RPC client over a socket, makes an example RPC call, and processes the response.

methods.name: spawnClient
methods.description: Forks a process and runs 'childProcessMain' in the child, passing the socket descriptor.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when a client disconnects, logs client process and user IDs.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that sets up the IPC server, socketpair, spawns a client process, and runs the event loop.
